observations.behavior: Adds a new shell function that lists all Docker containers on the host, including their status and project/service labels, regardless of whether the script is watching them.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help PostHog DevOps diagnose why a Docker service container failed to start or disappeared, distinguishing between a container that never started, started and died, or a container running under an unwatched project name. The script is used in CI or deployment contexts, not production customer environments.
